_about: Notebook names, shared by tests/test_notebook_names_table.py (tit/server/notebooks.py normalise_name) and desktop/tests/unit/notebook-names-table.test.ts (pages/notebooks/index.tsx proposeName, which names an imported .ipynb file before the server sees it). groundTruth: authored -- verdicts are written by hand from the rule both sides state: one path segment that starts with an ASCII letter or digit, then up to 127 of letters, digits, space, '.', '_' or '-'; surrounding whitespace is trimmed and one '.ipynb' suffix is dropped first; only the server accepts the single 'examples/' folder (an imported file's name never carries a folder). client = what proposeName returns (null = refused); server = what normalise_name returns (null = NotebookError). Where the two legitimately differ the row says why. length, when present, is the name's character count, checked so a mistyped literal cannot pass for the boundary it claims to test. 2026-10-22.

rows.why: a space before the suffix stays part of the name
rows.name: abc .ipynb

rows.why: a newline before the suffix is not an allowed character
rows.name:
abc
.ipynb

rows.why: the example notebook's own name: the server accepts the examples/ folder; an imported file's name never carries a folder, so the client refuses it
rows.name: examples/example_workflow.ipynb

rows.why: an upper-case suffix: the client drops it case-insensitively before sending, the server takes '.IPYNB' as part of the name
rows.name: Analysis.IPYNB
